type.description: VMware Engine network type. Possible values are: `LEGACY`, `STANDARD`.
type.rationale: The network type determines the VMware Engine network mode. STANDARD should be used instead of LEGACY because legacy network types may not align with current security and operational standards.

location.description: The location where the VMwareEngineNetwork should reside.
location.rationale: The location determines where the VMware Engine network is created. Approved regions help meet organisational, compliance, and data governance requirements.

name.rationale: Network names should follow an approved naming standard so that resources can be clearly identified, audited, and managed consistently.

description.description: User-provided description for this VMware Engine network.
description.rationale: The description is used for documentation and does not directly change the security behaviour of the network.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project determines where the VMware Engine network is created. Using an approved project helps keep the network within the correct governance, access control, and billing boundary.
